title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Eighth edition, Volume 6, Burning glasses-Climate - EB.16
text: Tellurium is found, but very rarely, combined with gold, they lead, and bismuth, in the Transylvania nanae. In appearance is resembles antimony, and its specific gravity is f2600. With oxygen it forms two acids, tellurous acid, as O<sub>2</sub> and tellursic acid, Te O<sub>2</sub> corresponding to sulphur- ous and sulphuric acids.
